explication: AI Hedge Fund is an educational research and trading-simulation application. A user builds or loads a ticker-free fund mandate, supplies a universe, then runs a cycle: point-in-time market data feeds alpha models, signals are blended, risk limits are applied, orders are simulated, and a cycle record/NAV is returned. The same fund can be iterated for backtests; independent event studies compute earnings CARs. The tree and excerpts support these major paths, but some TUI and backtest details were unsampled.
